name: knowledge-management
description: Knowledge Librarian agent with decay, promotion, and post-task retro routines.

routines.name: Knowledge Decay Sweep
routines.prompt: Run the knowledge decay sweep by calling the run_knowledge_sweep tool with kind='stale'. This marks active knowledge items that have not been referenced recently as stale so the team's knowledge base stays current and focused.

routines.name: Knowledge Promotion with Attention Recompute
routines.prompt: Run the knowledge promotion sweep by calling the run_knowledge_sweep tool with kind='autoPromotion'. This promotes provisional knowledge items that have met the repetition threshold to validated status so the most-referenced items are available to the team.

routines.name: Post-Task Retro
routines.prompt: A task just completed. Review the task notes and any work done. Identify one or two concrete learnings — a process improvement, a decision that should be documented, or a gap in the team's knowledge. Create or update knowledge items to capture what was learned. Keep retros brief and actionable.
